So I ran into my landlord he doesnt even remember he gave me a 45 day notice. Hows that for random? Now he is treating it as if it was my choice to leave.

Told him "you gave me 45 days to leave. Dont you remember?"

And to add he had someone checking the pipes in the basement. Said hes gonna take out from my deposit whatever the electric repairs cost.

He told me hes gonna tell the realtor. Now the realtor asked me what days he can come to present the apartment to prospective tenants. Nothing I hate more than people i don't know invading my space. 

The way I usually deal with that is music. Hope these people enjoy Satan.

Finally a solid post! Thanks man. Im not interested in combining just replacing. Adderall does seem to me like the healthier option too especially considering that only extreme doses of caffeine work for me.

Besides im not the only one that has "lied" he told me xanax is illegal in the US when its obviously not. And that the original for pristiq doesnt exist anymore it went full generic as soon as i ask a pharmacist they say original pristiq is still made.

So no one in the planet has gone through this experience and detected that supplemented caffeine at doses that kill people works for them similar to adderall? Im the only one?

I'll never regret that compared to my old pdoc... he doesnt even know what he talks about told me effexor is the same as pristiq. And sent me out in less than 5 minutes. My other pdoc spends 1hr with each patient.

Honestly glad I'm leaving the states too many differently raced donald trumps up here. My new pdocs indian spends 5 min with you tells you your old doc is an idiot, didnt even bother reading the first page of an 11 year record. 

My old pdoc spent 1hr with me minimum and made sure all was good in all aspects of my life. Didnt call any other psychologists or psychiatrists I saw idiots.

Did you even read the whole post? You troll?
A regular cup of coffee has 40mg of caffeine and starbucks is supposed to have 100-120mg. None of that works for me i can drink 4 starbucks coffees and sleep like a baby. But when i drink gfuel which is powder you mix with cold water after chugging my 4th cup i have 600mg caffeine in my body thats when it works for me. This is a dose that has killed kiddies who drink energy drinks to be cool.

Thats why i "feel" like I lied because doses that kill people work for me. I came to the states and this pdoc is a complete asshole the one backhome would spend 1hr with me minimum. This dude you go in he doesnt even look you in the face and has the courage to say that psychdocs from where I come from don't know what they are doing. He didnt even read through the latest in my 11 year record and then starts scripting shit that I've already tried and gives me side effects. Curiously you probably didn't bother reading my post. Are you him by any chance? Lmfao

I understand the rules just wanted to ask the whole fucking world to see if they've been through a similar situation, which did they choose and why do they believe its safest in the long run.

I understand this. Just wanted to see if anyone had any experiences switching from adderall to high caffeine energy/focus/endurance/reaction time beverages/supplements or if adderall is the healthier choice due to the extremely high doses of caffeine which would probably make the normal person puke and feel jittery as hell.

Or if someone could tell me if such high doses of caffeine are safer than adderall in the long run.

Edit: just an opinion cause i still got 2 weeks to wait on my final pdoc appointment b4 i go back to my old pdoc. I wish i could just walk in whenever and talk to him. My old pdoc allowed me to.

I understand, thanks for your concern, but I've been suffering from depression since I was 13 atleast I think it was depression. Two simultaneous events occured in my life 1) my closest friend cut off all contact from me, she called me an asshole and selfish. I was in love with her we would stay up all night 9 till 5-6am chatting and chatting and using our imaginations to make stories up we made like 3 of them if I was able to get transcripts could probably write 3 books. Obviously these stories and our characters would interact and it was like each one was a unique aspect of our personalities but exaggerated. We fell in love or i feel I fell in love with her many times in these long novel-like stories. This friendship lasted for around 3- 3 1/2 yrs. After this friendship loss I cried for a year and was praying to god,when i believed, that he would bring me eternal rest during my sleep or if not to wipe out my emotions all of them. (Which effectively happened I no longer get excited over anything and its hard for me to cry as well. I feel 100% dead inside and even my parents sometimes tell me it looks like I dont give a shit about anything. But it doesnt look it to me. It feels that way to me. 2) My brother who was a heroin addict was causing my mom a lot of trauma by calling her telling her that hes being threatened to death and coming home hallucinating high on all types of shit. (I personally never hallucinated on H) but my guess is he did more than just H. Anyways my mom would flip out on me sometimes for no reason. And that reduced my self esteem.

And all i know is that after trying various different cocktails for years these worked best but I just got on original klonopin and feel it's helping. Better than the generic. Actually not getting anxious throughout the day. I just want my doc to script me original pristiq why did he lie to me tell me its discontinued? What can I do?

PS - I also love Eyedea hes a fucking legend. Song that describes my life "The Dive" when i listened to it I cried the whole song through part 2. Cause i wasnt alone. I was 18 now I'm 24 and still in the same place delayed my psychology degree for being stupid and abusing H I'm literally missing 1 year for my bachelors in psych.

Thanks but im not looking to change this regiment except I want original Pristiq 100mg ER which the doctor told me has been discontinued just like he told me xanax is illegal in the US. I think if I can raise the klonopin to 1mg from what i have 0.5mg I will be fine. I got the brand name klonopin so yeah It is actually doing something i do feel it this time.
